title: Beetle mortality and insecticide dose (Bliss, 1935)
intro: Published data (Bliss, 1935, as tabled by Dobson and Barnett, An Introduction to Generalized Linear Models): flour beetles exposed for five hours to carbon disulphide gas at eight doses (log₁₀ mg per litre), with the numbers tested and killed. The empirical logit ln((killed + 0.5)/(survived + 0.5)) is regressed on the log dose; LD50 is where the logit is 0.
